messages:
lee_csm: Heads-up: OnboardCorp asked for a short SLO recap and the credit calc for last week's latency spike. They want numbers for the quarter + an explanation for the blip so renewal team can review.

nina_ops: which environment? prod hosted us-west?

lee_csm: yes, prod us-west. deadline Tue EOD.

nina_ops: ok. we'll need uptime% (quarter), p50/p95 latency, incident window, RCA note, and exported PNGs/CSV of the graphs.

marta_se: I can assemble a one-slide summary and an appendix. can someone share the PromQL used to compute p95?

nina_ops: for internal use we use: ``histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job))``. uptime simple check: ``sum(up == 1) / count(up) * 100`` over the quarter range. for the customer doc we'll use dashboard exports to avoid query complexity.

tom_oncall: SLO-bot recorded a breach on 2467342000. timeline matches a deploy + cache clear. ops notes: KV cache priming caused p95 jump for ~17m. deploy log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T18:02:59Z deploy: model-optimize-v1 rolling
2026-03-14T18:06:10Z cache: clear prefix /user-cache
2026-03-14T18:23:10Z metrics: p95 latency 380ms -> 1.1s
```

lee_csm: thanks. Tom, can you add the exact start/end timestamps and attach the export? We'll include an FAQ on credits per legal.

tom_oncall: adding to ticket CS-7920. attaching Prometheus csv + Grafana PNGs in the ticket. incident window per slo-bot: 2026-03-14T18:06:00Z - 2026-03-14T18:23:00Z.

marta_se: draft outline: 1) headline: uptime% and credit owed 2) timeline + visuals 3) technical root cause 4) mitigation plan 5) credits FAQ. I'll populate once artifacts are attached.

lee_csm: Alex from renewals asked that the credit calc be explicit. standard calc: prorated minutes of downtime beyond SLO threshold * monthly fee factor. please include sample row: "Duration (min): 17 -> Credit = (17/43200)*monthly_fee" and explain rounding and timing to issue credits.

nina_ops: we've pushed evidence to shared drive: /shared/CS/OnboardCorp/SLO_packet_2467895321/ . ops will also recommend mitigations: staggered cache warms, deploy ramp to reduce priming tail.

lee_csm: perfect. i'll review the slide Mon morning and send customer Tue EOD. add :thumbsup: if you own any item.

marta_se: i'll own the slide + FAQ.

tom_oncall: i'll own the logs/exports and add the RCA blurb.

slo-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach recorded for OnboardCorp (prod us-west). window 2026-03-14T18:06:00Z - 2026-03-14T18:23:00Z. ticket CS-7920 created. :rotating_light:

lee_csm: thanks all — this helps for the renewal playbook.

nina_ops: noted. will update runbook to include cache warmup stagger and a pre-warm check in the deploy pipeline.

lee_csm: closing loop: once the PDF is ready, ping me and i'll share with the customer. thanks! :thumbsup:
